phrases.latin: Crustula contūsa in fundum fōrmae digitīs preme.
phrases.english: Press the crushed biscuits into the bottom of the tin with your fingers.

phrases.latin: vel manū figūrātur vel buxeīs fōrmīs exprimitur
phrases.english: it is either shaped by hand or pressed in boxwood moulds

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 364.
